text:
Experience: 1 years
• Test the complete customer journey, from QR-code scanning to the intended emergency-contact workflow.

• Prepare and execute test cases and test scenarios.

• Perform functional, integration, regression, compatibility and usability testing.

• Test across different browsers, smartphones and screen sizes.

• Identify, document and track bugs with clear reproduction steps and screenshots.

• Test error handling, invalid inputs, network interruptions and repeated scans.

• Perform basic API testing using Postman.

• Retest resolved defects and maintain test documentation.

• Collaborate with developers to investigate issues and validate releases.

• Report testing progress, risks and unresolved defects.

 Required skills

• Understanding of manual software testing and the software testing life cycle.

• Ability to write test cases and detailed bug reports.

• Experience testing web applications.

• Strong logical thinking, attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

• Basic knowledge of API testing; Postman experience is desirable.

• Clear written and verbal communication.

• Willingness to learn the product and take ownership of testing activities.

 Good to have

• Experience testing WhatsApp or other third-party integrations.

• Basic SQL knowledge.

• Exposure to Jira, Trello or similar bug-tracking tools.

• Basic automation testing knowledge.

 Who should apply?
 Candidates who enjoy finding problems, questioning assumptions and improving product reliability. We value practical skills, ownership and learning ability over certifications alone.
 Application: Please send your CV, current location, notice period, current salary and expected salary to [insert your recruitment email address]. Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical testing assessment.
